answer.text:
According to Utz Brands, Inc.'s Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024, under **Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations** (Chunk ID: `14e6d7a8-d96c-5bc1-a7d5-febc26908e92`):

### **Reported Figures (Fiscal Year Ended December 29, 2024):**
* **Gross profit:** $494,777 thousand (or $494.8 million)
* **Net sales:** $1,409,281 thousand (or $1,409.3 million)

---

### **Calculation:**
$$\text{Gross Profit Margin Percentage} = \frac{\text{Gross Profit}}{\text{Net Sales}} = \frac{\$494,777}{\$1,409,281} \approx 35.1084\%$$

Using the millions figures:
$$\frac{\$494.8\text{ million}}{\$1,409.3\text{ million}} \approx 35.1096\%$$

The filing also explicitly states:
> *"Our gross profit margin was **35.1%** for the fiscal year ended December 29, 2024 versus 31.7% for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023."*
